items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) against the Bürgergeld decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland, Seelower Weg 12, 15344 Musterstrausberg einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday) was sent as 'einfacher Brief'. Per the letter's own rule (current §37 Abs. 2 SGB X, '4-day fiction' in force since the 2025 postal-law reform), Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) = date of dispatch + 4 calendar days = 19.11.2026 + 4 = 23.11.2026 (Monday). That day is neither a weekend day nor a Brandenburg public holiday, so no shift applies; Bekanntgabe stands at 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs from the day after Bekanntgabe (§187 Abs. 1 BGB), but under §188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the Bekanntgabe day itself, i.e. the 23rd. One month after 23.11.2026 is 23.12.2026 (Wednesday) - not a weekend or Brandenburg holiday, so this is the final day the Widerspruch must reach the Jobcenter.

items.title: Submit landlord's 2025 utility/heating cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie die Nebenkostenabrechnung Ihres Vermieters für 2025 bis 08.01.2027 ein.
items.computation: The letter gives an explicit calendar deadline of 08.01.2027 for submitting the 2025 Nebenkostenabrechnung. 08.01.2027 is a Friday, not a weekend day or a Brandenburg public holiday, so the stated date stands unchanged as the final day.
